incident.summary: UAOS could make correct logical authority/deliberation decisions while a raw ChatGPT GitHub connector with unrestricted write permission could still mutate unprotected main outside Python ActionCoordinator. CAS protected against stale overwrite but did not mediate authority or admission.

root_cause: Policy decision and policy enforcement were conflated: Python/host cognition could decide correctly without owning every physical write path.
Observed-HEAD CAS was treated as the normal production promotion mechanism even though CAS is concurrency control, not access control or complete mediation.
GitHub main had no active ruleset/branch protection, so the raw connector and owner-level writers retained a direct production path.
The prior evolution lifecycle allowed RESOLVED while a known bypass was classified as a limitation rather than as a blocker to the claimed mutation invariant.

MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: direct-main noop connector write occurred despite logical mutation rules
GitHub rulesets endpoint returned an empty list
ChatGPT GitHub plugin permission was observed as app-specific Allow all actions
MACRO_GOAL_AND_TOPOLOGY_ALIGNMENT: all production mutations must traverse one non-bypassable host policy-enforcement point
GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected assumption: a correct model-side/Python admission gate is enough when another writer bypasses it
rejected assumption: CAS promotion provides authorization
rejected assumption: Custom Instructions can serve as a security boundary
EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH: GitHub repository rulesets with required pull request and required status checks
OpenAI Custom Instructions cross-chat application semantics
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH: raw connector direct-main update is a concrete counterexample to complete mediation
a prompt-only sentinel can be ignored or bypassed by a separate host write path
ruleset bypass for the same GitHub App would recreate the same failure under a different name

complexity_delta.new_always_on_component: lightweight mutation sentinel within existing session/authority policies
complexity_delta.new_host_enforcement: GitHub ruleset; external platform mechanism rather than another UAOS controller

acceptance: candidate full CI passes with promotion-gate status
authority-wide contradiction scan finds no current direct-main normal-promotion rule
ChatGPT GitHub host permission is no longer unrestricted silent-write while ruleset remains absent, or another equivalent temporary host control is active
GitHub main ruleset is active and read back from the remote API
ruleset requires PR and promotion-gate, blocks force-push/delete, and grants no ChatGPT GitHub App bypass
a material production mutation can be promoted through the protected path
post-promotion production authority is reread and observed
only then may this incident become RESOLVED
